content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"gap","note":"The path from witness evidence to the reprimand and SOT conclusions is traceable, but the harassment conclusions for 'incidents 1-4, and 6-11' and 'claims 9 and 10' rely on a claim list never set out in the record, and 'event 7' (the Medical Provider and the May 6, 2021 visit) has no supporting background, so those conclusions cannot be reconstructed."},"rc2":{"status":"review","note":"Complainant's allegations and the alcohol-policy witness accounts carry ROI page cites (e.g., ROI at 124-5, 147, 248-9), but the analysis-stage characterizations have no record citations, including 'Management officials testified that there were no other officers who engaged in similar behavior,' the Medical Provider testimony, and the finding that concerns were first raised May 14, 2021."},"rc3":{"status":"review","note":"Key events are dated (October 24, 2020; December 2020; December 3, 2020; May 5, 13 and 14, 2021), but the record gives no dates for Complainant's prior EEO activity, her complaint filing, or the hearing withdrawal, and the claimed first-complaint date of May 14, 2021 is not reconciled with her reported disclosure of the October 2020 conversation to Witness 2."},"rc4":{"status":"review","note":"The criteria applied are stated (prima facie elements, pretext, the hostile and abusive harassment standard) and Complainant's rebuttal about the Manager's drinking was considered, but the final-decision maker and the 'responsible management official' are not identified, and the record does not show that Complainant's report to Witness 2 was weighed on claim 5."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"An independent reviewer could evaluate the alcohol-policy discipline from the record. The record cannot stand alone on the harassment claims because of the undefined claim numbering, the unexplained event 7, the uncited management testimony, and the unresolved conflict over when Complainant first raised the Manager's comments."}}}
